prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): none
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Desktop Controls Interactive Guide', 'Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Pet Customization Guided Wizard', 'Pick Friend Split Screen Redesign']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Preset Pet Quick-Start Sub-Flow', 'Adoption Certificate Badge Reward', 'Interactive Desktop Pet Preview Stage', 'Photo Quality Verification Sub-Flow', 'Path Selection Reward Incentive', 'Desktop Controls Quick Start Cards', 'Adoption Certificate Confirmation Redesign', 'Pet Welcome Treat Reward Incentive']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as no category has at least 2 tests yet.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to actual noise-corrected results.
No kind of change has been helpful yet, as no tests have won.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout to showcase the companion certificate prominently.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion to 60.9% and takes a median duration of 89s (mean 1017s).

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your desktop companion's details to complete the adoption process.

candidates.title: Home Waiting Estimate & Notification
candidates.change: Display an estimated waiting timer and enable desktop notifications while the pet is initializing.
candidates.why: The waiting step has an extreme mean duration of 2336s, causing user drops during desktop pet generation.

waiting.hint: We are bringing your pet to life! You will be notified as soon as it arrives on your desktop.

candidates.title: Sign-In Data Protection Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent explanatory hint on the sign-in screen explaining that logging in preserves pet customization across sessions.
candidates.why: Support received 8 separate emails reporting lost or reset pets after re-signing into the app.

sign_in.hint: Signing in links your desktop pet securely to your account so you never lose your companion or progress.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Controls Guide Screen
candidates.change: Insert a clear desktop controls introduction screen after completing onboarding to explain pet interaction and visibility controls.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and multiple users wrote to support confused about how to hide or talk to their pet.

new_desktop_controls_overview.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_desktop_controls_overview.body: Right-click your pet anytime to hide, chat, or access settings right from your desktop toolbar.

candidates.title: Simplified Path Selection Copy
candidates.change: Simplify headline and body copy on choose_path screen to clarify choices and reduce hesitation.
candidates.why: Path selection takes a high mean duration of 514s and loses 23.8% of users right at the beginning.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Create Your Pet
choose_path.body: Pick quick setup to adopt immediately or custom photo setup to create a unique companion.

candidates.title: Early Path Selection Reorder
candidates.change: Place the path selection step before the story introduction screen so users immediately pick their setup path on launch.
candidates.why: Accelerates initial engagement and cuts down high mean decision times (514s) at start.

candidates.title: Photo Guidelines Pre-Upload Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a photo guidelines sub-flow screen right before photo uploads to prevent custom generation errors.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or malformed output during photo adoption.

new_photo_guidelines.headline: Tips for Great Custom Pets
new_photo_guidelines.body: Upload clear, well-lit front photos for best pet creation results.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Notification
candidates.change: Configure desktop notification alerts when home welcome screen displays so users notice pet launch on screen.
candidates.why: Support received complaints about pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to open visually.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Look at your screen! Your new companion is now running on your desktop.

candidates.title: Path Progress Indicator
candidates.change: Show onboarding step progress counter and progress bar during path selection.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low (17.8%), and showing step progress early sets clear completion expectations.

candidates.title: Sign-In Split Screen Layout
candidates.change: Change sign-in screen to a split layout showcasing account benefits alongside sign-in options.
candidates.why: Sign in converts at 72.9% with 8 support issues tied to lost account pets.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Companion Account
sign_in.body: Sign in to back up your desktop pet and sync settings across devices.
